reason: I might download it for the free green curry out of curiosity, but I already cook kaprao without help, and when I get stuck I call my mum or ask a free AI chat. Spending 99 baht of my allowance on recipes my family and cooking clips give me for free isn't happening in a normal week.
objection: A free AI chat and the cooking clips I watch every night already answer my questions, and my mum's recipes are the ones I actually trust, so I can't see what the 99 baht gets me that I don't already have for free.
would_change_my_mind: A friend telling me they cooked from the pack and the Sunday plans really got their meals well under the 50 baht a plate costs.
